allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File work | Select-Object @{n='Path';e={$_.FullName.Substring\(\(Get-Location\).Path.Length+1\)}}, @{n='KB';e={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}} | Sort-Object Path | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem design\\assets\\illustrations -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, @{n='KB';e={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(git status --short --ignored; Write-Output '--- .obsidian ---'; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File .obsidian -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object @{n='Path';e={$_.FullName.Substring\(\(Get-Location\).Path.Length+1\)}}, @{n='KB';e={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(git stash list; Write-Output '=== stash@{0} vs arquivo atual ==='; git diff stash@{0} -- .claude/settings.json 2>$null | Select-Object -First 40)

PowerShell(git show 'stash@{0}:.claude/settings.json' | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$env:TEMP\\stash-settings.json"; $a = \(Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\stash-settings.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).permissions.allow; $b = \(Get-Content .claude\\settings.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).permissions.allow; Write-Output "stash: $\($a.Count\) permissoes | atual: $\($b.Count\) permissoes"; Write-Output '=== no stash e ausentes no atual ==='; Compare-Object $a $b | Where-Object SideIndicator -eq '<=' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty InputObject)
PowerShell(git stash drop 'stash@{0}'; Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\\stash-settings.json" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; git add .claude/settings.json; git status --short)
